risk_summary: The excerpt presents a generally confident performance and capital outlook, supported by substantial quantitative disclosures on earnings, capital ratios, revenue expectations, expenses, and repurchases. Risk transparency is diluted by extensive forward-looking-statement disclaimers, broad qualifying language, and reliance on management judgment for fair-value estimates. Exposure to interest-rate pressure, market liquidity, regulatory methodology changes, and subjective Level 3 valuations remains material.
